method: Native RGB without resampling; R>=G>=B, R-B>32, 255-B>=threshold; scipy eight-connected components. All components retained at thresholds32,64,96. This local warm-color predicate is exploratory and not specific to four-bolt gold.
selection: Single AI visual inspection of descending gold pair after F3. Region is not the final quantile sample and does not define complete support.
interpretation: One long component is consistent with the visually proposed gold solid descent. Smaller components track a nearby broken route but merge or separate as threshold changes. Two upper-right groups around x415-424, y6-19 are outside the visually proposed gold descending route and may be neighboring red pixels; retained as potential contamination, not assigned to gold.
limits: Threshold32 merges candidate dash fragments that separate at64/96; connectivity is not true dash topology.
Long component touches top/bottom of the crop; rightmost component touches its right boundary. None is a physical endpoint.
No deletion of suspected contamination or nearest-label winner selection.
Bounding boxes are not full pixel masks or calibrated uncertainty envelopes.
No model-identity acceptance, continuous support, physical ordinate or discrepancy metric.

separate_code_check.method: Scalar RGB predicate and set/depth-first component traversal reproduced the original NumPy/SciPy labeling. Same analyst and source; not independent human identity recovery.

local_identity_calibration_review: Requested human distinction of the black and gold solid/dashed routes in the unchanged Im4 strip. No response inferred. This calibration is additional to, not a replacement for, the final deterministic 42-slot sample review.
